pages.text: Draconic Evolution reactors can be run from OpenComputers too. Whatever you use, $(l)test it on a reactor you can afford to lose$() and keep a manual shutdown plan.$(br2)For ComputerCraft, see $(l)drmon$() in the ComputerCraft chapter.

$(l)Draconic Control$() (XyFreak): GUI, config file, multiple reactors. Needs a $(l)Lua 5.2$() CPU: sneak-right-click the CPU in the air to switch (OC defaults to 5.3).$(br2)$(l)wget http://xypm.tenyx.de/standalone/dc_installer.lua$() then $(l)dc_installer$()
Setup guide and requirements for Draconic Control.
$(l)reactor-control$() (Jonathan Ramos Weigend) - single file for MC 1.12.2. It drives two flux gates; check that it picked the right gate for input and output before relying on it.
$(l)DEReactor Complete Control$() - works on both OpenComputers and ComputerCraft.
